text:
#### 2. Internet Banking Platform (IBP)  
**System ID:** IBP-001
**Purpose:** Web-based customer portal for account access and self-service
**Technology:** React.js frontend, Node.js backend
**Deployment:** Cloud (AWS)
**Availability:** 99.8% (SLA)  
**Key Features:**
- Secure login (username/password + OTP)
- Account information dashboard
- Transaction history and search
- Standing orders and direct debits
- Beneficiary management
- Money transfer
- E-statements
- Profile and settings management  
**Security:**
- TLS 1.3 encryption
- Session management (15-min idle timeout)
- Two-factor authentication (OTP via email/SMS)
- XSS/CSRF protection
- SQL injection prevention  
**Usage:**
- Daily active users: 200–300
- Peak traffic: 10:00–12:00 GMT
- Response time: <2 seconds (p95)  
**Integration:**
- Account Management System (AMS) — account data
- Fraud Detection Engine — transaction validation
- Payment Processing System (PPS) — transfer execution

raw_entities.name: Internet Banking Platform
raw_entities.description: Web-based customer portal enabling self-service account access, transaction management, and payment operations. Built on React.js frontend and Node.js backend, deployed on AWS cloud infrastructure with 99.8% availability SLA. Provides secure login via username/password and OTP, account dashboards, transaction history, standing orders, direct debits, beneficiary management, money transfers, and e-statements.
context: Web-based customer portal for account access and self-service

raw_entities.name: Account Management System
raw_entities.description: Core banking system providing account data integration to the Internet Banking Platform. Serves as the authoritative source for customer account information accessed through IBP.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Detection Engine
raw_entities.description: System responsible for transaction validation and fraud detection, integrated with the Internet Banking Platform to monitor and validate customer transactions in real-time.

raw_entities.name: Payment Processing System
raw_entities.description: System that executes money transfer and payment operations initiated through the Internet Banking Platform, handling the settlement and processing of customer-initiated transfers.

raw_entities.name: Internet Banking Platform Availability Target
raw_entities.description: Service level agreement specifying the required uptime for the Internet Banking Platform.

raw_entities.name: Internet Banking Platform Response Time Target
raw_entities.description: Performance target for the 95th percentile response time of the Internet Banking Platform under normal operating conditions.

raw_entities.name: Internet Banking Platform Daily Active Users
raw_entities.description: Operational metric tracking the typical daily active user count on the Internet Banking Platform.

raw_entities.name: Session Idle Timeout Control
raw_entities.description: Security control requiring automatic session termination after 15 minutes of user inactivity on the Internet Banking Platform to protect against unauthorized access.

raw_entities.name: Two-Factor Authentication Requirement
raw_entities.description: Security control mandating two-factor authentication via OTP delivered through email or SMS for all Internet Banking Platform logins.

raw_entities.name: TLS 1.3 Encryption Standard
raw_entities.description: Encryption standard requirement for all data in transit on the Internet Banking Platform, enforcing TLS 1.3 protocol.

raw_entities.name: XSS and CSRF Protection Requirement
raw_entities.description: Security control requiring implementation of Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) protection mechanisms on the Internet Banking Platform.

raw_entities.name: SQL Injection Prevention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Security control requiring implementation of SQL injection prevention mechanisms across the Internet Banking Platform backend systems.

raw_entities.name: Standing Order
raw_entities.description: A recurring payment instruction that customers can set up, manage, and cancel through the Internet Banking Platform as part of self-service payment capabilities.

raw_entities.name: Direct Debit
raw_entities.description: A payment mandate that customers can establish and manage through the Internet Banking Platform for recurring payments to third parties.

raw_entities.name: Transaction
raw_entities.description: Financial events on customer accounts including deposits, withdrawals, transfers, and payments that are displayed in transaction history and monitored for fraud through the Internet Banking Platform.

raw_entities.name: Money Transfer
raw_entities.description: A customer-initiated payment operation executed through the Internet Banking Platform and processed by the Payment Processing System.

raw_entities.name: Beneficiary
raw_entities.description: A third-party recipient that customers can register and manage through the Internet Banking Platform for payment and transfer operations.
